trophies.guide:
1. [CONFIRMED] Finish the story first, then open Progress, Stats, 100% Completion and work the checklist. [1]
2. [CONFIRMED] The checklist needs: all robberies, all underwater discoveries, all shooting range challenges, all drone races, and the Bret quest line. [1][2]
3. [CONFIRMED] Scan 200 of 277 vehicles and 100 of 255 animals while you travel. [1][2]
4. [CONFIRMED] Complete 15 of 18 card sets, 70 of 80 challenges, and find 100 flamingos and 33 underwater discoveries. [1][2]
5. [CONFIRMED] Robberies for 100%: 39 gang operations, 22 bank jobs, 7 payday loan jobs. [2]
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide:

2. [CONFIRMED] The counter runs across the whole playthrough; grind the remainder after the story with fast cars and ramps. [1]
3. [CONFIRMED] Track progress with the count tracker on this trophy. [1]

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide:

2. [CONFIRMED] Most unlock naturally during the story and Stage 2 cleanup. [2]
3. [CONFIRMED] Use the count tracker to tick types off as you try them. [2]

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.

3. [CONFIRMED] All 42 are required for 100% completion as well, so do them in Stage 2. [1]
